requirements.quote:
AS_PATH is a well-known mandatory attribute.  This attribute
   identifies the autonomous systems through which routing information
   carried in this UPDATE message has passed.  The components of this
   list can be AS_SETs or AS_SEQUENCEs.
requirements.condition: When handling the AS_PATH path attribute
requirements.required_behavior: Treat AS_PATH as a well-known mandatory attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: The attribute classification and mandatory-attribute handling are concrete parser and serializer properties.

requirements.quote:
AS_PATH is a well-known mandatory attribute.  This attribute
   identifies the autonomous systems through which routing information
   carried in this UPDATE message has passed.  The components of this
   list can be AS_SETs or AS_SEQUENCEs.
requirements.condition: When representing the path of routing information in an UPDATE
requirements.required_behavior: Use AS_PATH to identify the autonomous systems through which the routing information has passed.
requirements.why_checkable: The advertised AS numbers can be compared with the route propagation history.

requirements.quote:
AS_PATH is a well-known mandatory attribute.  This attribute
   identifies the autonomous systems through which routing information
   carried in this UPDATE message has passed.  The components of this
   list can be AS_SETs or AS_SEQUENCEs.
requirements.condition: When encoding components of an AS_PATH
requirements.required_behavior: Use AS_SET or AS_SEQUENCE components.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded path segment types can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
a) When a given BGP speaker advertises the route to an internal
         peer, the advertising speaker SHALL NOT modify the AS_PATH
         attribute associated with the route.
requirements.condition: When advertising to an internal peer a route learned from another BGP speaker
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Modify the AS_PATH attribute associated with the route.
requirements.why_checkable: The learned and internally advertised AS_PATH values can be compared byte for byte.

requirements.quote:
1) if the first path segment of the AS_PATH is of type
            AS_SEQUENCE, the local system prepends its own AS number as
            the last element of the sequence (put it in the leftmost
            position with respect to the position of octets in the
            protocol message).  If the act of prepending will cause an
            overflow in the AS_PATH segment (i.e., more than 255 ASes),
            it SHOULD prepend a new segment of type AS_SEQUENCE and
            prepend its own AS number to this new segment.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route to an external peer and its first AS_PATH segment is AS_SEQUENCE, subject to the stated overflow handling
requirements.required_behavior: Prepend the local AS number as the last element of the sequence, in the leftmost octet position in the protocol message; configured repeated local-AS insertion is permitted.
requirements.why_checkable: The outgoing first segment and the wire position of the inserted local AS number can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
1) if the first path segment of the AS_PATH is of type
            AS_SEQUENCE, the local system prepends its own AS number as
            the last element of the sequence (put it in the leftmost
            position with respect to the position of octets in the
            protocol message).  If the act of prepending will cause an
            overflow in the AS_PATH segment (i.e., more than 255 ASes),
            it SHOULD prepend a new segment of type AS_SEQUENCE and
            prepend its own AS number to this new segment.
requirements.condition: When encoding an AS_PATH segment
requirements.required_behavior: Limit a path segment to at most 255 AS numbers.
requirements.why_checkable: Segment cardinality has the explicit overflow boundary of 255 ASes.

requirements.quote:
1) if the first path segment of the AS_PATH is of type
            AS_SEQUENCE, the local system prepends its own AS number as
            the last element of the sequence (put it in the leftmost
            position with respect to the position of octets in the
            protocol message).  If the act of prepending will cause an
            overflow in the AS_PATH segment (i.e., more than 255 ASes),
            it SHOULD prepend a new segment of type AS_SEQUENCE and
            prepend its own AS number to this new segment.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route externally and prepending to its initial AS_SEQUENCE would exceed 255 ASes
requirements.required_behavior: SHOULD prepend a new AS_SEQUENCE segment to the AS_PATH.
requirements.why_checkable: A full first segment exercises the recommended new-segment branch.

requirements.quote:
1) if the first path segment of the AS_PATH is of type
            AS_SEQUENCE, the local system prepends its own AS number as
            the last element of the sequence (put it in the leftmost
            position with respect to the position of octets in the
            protocol message).  If the act of prepending will cause an
            overflow in the AS_PATH segment (i.e., more than 255 ASes),
            it SHOULD prepend a new segment of type AS_SEQUENCE and
            prepend its own AS number to this new segment.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route externally and prepending to its initial AS_SEQUENCE would exceed 255 ASes
requirements.required_behavior: SHOULD prepend the local AS number to the new AS_SEQUENCE segment.
requirements.why_checkable: The newly prepended segment can be inspected for the local AS number.

requirements.quote:
2) if the first path segment of the AS_PATH is of type AS_SET,
            the local system prepends a new path segment of type
            AS_SEQUENCE to the AS_PATH, including its own AS number in
            that segment.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route externally and the first AS_PATH segment is AS_SET
requirements.required_behavior: Prepend a new AS_SEQUENCE path segment to the AS_PATH.
requirements.why_checkable: An AS_SET-leading input allows inspection of the outgoing segment type and order.

requirements.quote:
2) if the first path segment of the AS_PATH is of type AS_SET,
            the local system prepends a new path segment of type
            AS_SEQUENCE to the AS_PATH, including its own AS number in
            that segment.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route externally and the first AS_PATH segment is AS_SET
requirements.required_behavior: Include the local AS number in the newly prepended AS_SEQUENCE segment.
requirements.why_checkable: The inserted segment contents can be compared with the local AS configuration.

requirements.quote:
3) if the AS_PATH is empty, the local system creates a path
            segment of type AS_SEQUENCE, places its own AS into that
            segment, and places that segment into the AS_PATH.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route externally and the AS_PATH is empty
requirements.required_behavior: Create a path segment of type AS_SEQUENCE.
requirements.why_checkable: An empty-path input exercises segment creation and exposes its type.

requirements.quote:
3) if the AS_PATH is empty, the local system creates a path
            segment of type AS_SEQUENCE, places its own AS into that
            segment, and places that segment into the AS_PATH.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route externally and the AS_PATH is empty
requirements.required_behavior: Place the local AS number into the newly created AS_SEQUENCE segment.
requirements.why_checkable: The created segment contents can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
3) if the AS_PATH is empty, the local system creates a path
            segment of type AS_SEQUENCE, places its own AS into that
            segment, and places that segment into the AS_PATH.
requirements.condition: When advertising a learned route externally and the AS_PATH is empty
requirements.required_behavior: Place the newly created AS_SEQUENCE segment into the AS_PATH.
requirements.why_checkable: The outgoing AS_PATH can be checked for the created segment.

requirements.quote:
a) the originating speaker includes its own AS number in a path
         segment, of type AS_SEQUENCE, in the AS_PATH attribute of all
         UPDATE messages sent to an external peer.  In this case, the AS
         number of the originating speaker's autonomous system will be
         the only entry the path segment, and this path segment will be
         the only segment in the AS_PATH attribute.
requirements.condition: When originating a route and sending an UPDATE for it to an external peer
requirements.required_behavior: Include the originating speaker's own AS number in the AS_PATH of every such UPDATE.
requirements.why_checkable: Externally originated advertisements can be checked for the configured local AS.

requirements.quote:
a) the originating speaker includes its own AS number in a path
         segment, of type AS_SEQUENCE, in the AS_PATH attribute of all
         UPDATE messages sent to an external peer.  In this case, the AS
         number of the originating speaker's autonomous system will be
         the only entry the path segment, and this path segment will be
         the only segment in the AS_PATH attribute.
requirements.condition: When originating a route and sending an UPDATE for it to an external peer
requirements.required_behavior: Place the originating speaker's AS number in a segment of type AS_SEQUENCE.
requirements.why_checkable: The segment containing the originator AS has an inspectable type.

requirements.quote:
a) the originating speaker includes its own AS number in a path
         segment, of type AS_SEQUENCE, in the AS_PATH attribute of all
         UPDATE messages sent to an external peer.  In this case, the AS
         number of the originating speaker's autonomous system will be
         the only entry the path segment, and this path segment will be
         the only segment in the AS_PATH attribute.
requirements.condition: When originating a route and sending an UPDATE for it to an external peer, subject to locally configured repeated local-AS inclusion
requirements.required_behavior: The originating speaker's AS number is the only entry in the path segment.
requirements.why_checkable: The origin segment contents can be checked, while retaining the paragraph permitting configured repetition.

requirements.quote:
a) the originating speaker includes its own AS number in a path
         segment, of type AS_SEQUENCE, in the AS_PATH attribute of all
         UPDATE messages sent to an external peer.  In this case, the AS
         number of the originating speaker's autonomous system will be
         the only entry the path segment, and this path segment will be
         the only segment in the AS_PATH attribute.
requirements.condition: When originating a route and sending an UPDATE for it to an external peer
requirements.required_behavior: The segment containing the originating AS number is the only segment in AS_PATH.
requirements.why_checkable: The originating external advertisement has an inspectable segment count.

requirements.quote:
b) the originating speaker includes an empty AS_PATH attribute in
         all UPDATE messages sent to internal peers.  (An empty AS_PATH
         attribute is one whose length field contains the value zero).
requirements.condition: When originating a route and sending an UPDATE for it to an internal peer
requirements.required_behavior: Include an empty AS_PATH attribute in every such UPDATE.
requirements.why_checkable: Internal advertisements of local routes can be inspected for the present but empty attribute.

requirements.quote:
b) the originating speaker includes an empty AS_PATH attribute in
         all UPDATE messages sent to internal peers.  (An empty AS_PATH
         attribute is one whose length field contains the value zero).
requirements.condition: When encoding an empty AS_PATH attribute
requirements.required_behavior: Set its length field to zero.
requirements.why_checkable: The empty attribute length is a directly observable wire value.

requirements.quote:
Whenever the modification of the AS_PATH attribute calls for
   including or prepending the AS number of the local system, the local
   system MAY include/prepend more than one instance of its own AS
   number in the AS_PATH attribute.  This is controlled via local
   configuration.
requirements.condition: Whenever an AS_PATH modification calls for including or prepending the local AS number
requirements.required_behavior: MAY include or prepend more than one instance of the local AS number in AS_PATH.
requirements.why_checkable: Configured repeated insertion can be inspected without treating the optional behavior as mandatory.

requirements.quote:
Whenever the modification of the AS_PATH attribute calls for
   including or prepending the AS number of the local system, the local
   system MAY include/prepend more than one instance of its own AS
   number in the AS_PATH attribute.  This is controlled via local
   configuration.
requirements.condition: When including or prepending multiple instances of the local AS number in AS_PATH
requirements.required_behavior: Control repeated local-AS inclusion or prepending through local configuration.
requirements.why_checkable: Changing the relevant local configuration can be compared with the number of inserted local-AS instances.
